His female counterpart is {{ga|Rosa}}. ==In the core series== ===As the protagonist=== Nate is a young boy living in [[Aspertia City]] with his childhood friend [[Hugh]]. At the start of the game, he sets off with Hugh to collect his first Pokémon. They then go their separate ways, and he starts his {{pkmn|journey}} across the [[Unova]] region. ====Rental Pokémon in [[Pokéstar Studios]]==== :''For all rental teams used by the player at Pokéstar Studios, see [[Nate (game)/Pokéstar Studios|here]].'' ===As a non-playable character=== If the player chooses {{ga|Rosa}}, Nate will appear in-game as an NPC, first met in [[Nimbasa City]]. He will join the player in a [[Multi Battle]] against [[Emmet]] and [[Ingo]]. Afterwards, he will give the player the [[Vs. Recorder]]. Nate will then appear as the player's partner in the [[Battle Subway]] when choosing to ride the Multi-Train. Two of the following Pokémon are picked from the corresponding list, depending on what the player wants him to base his team on. {{color2|FFF|Pokéstar Studios}} | colspan=2| {{color2|FFF|Full Metal Cop Series|Ninja}} sprites from {{color2|FFF|Pokéstar Studios}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Nate (game)/Quotes}} ==Counterparts== ===In animation=== [[File:Nate B2W2 Trailer.png|thumb|250px|Nate in the animated trailer]] ====Pokémon Black 2 and White 2 Animated Trailer==== Nate appeared in the [[Pokémon Black Version 2 and Pokémon White Version 2 Animated Trailer]], first seen meeting [[Bianca]] together with [[Hugh]], choosing {{p|Tepig}} as his [[first partner Pokémon]]. He later appeared meeting [[Colress]] in [[Castelia City]], facing [[Elesa]] at the [[Nimbasa Gym]], battling [[Team Plasma]] aboard the [[Plasma Frigate]] alongside Hugh and [[Cheren]], and chasing a member of the [[Shadow Triad]] across the frozen [[Opelucid City]], but failing to recover the [[DNA Splicers|mysterious item]] they had stolen. =====Pokémon===== {{TrainerPoké |width=68 |trainer=Nate |pkmn=Emboar |stage1=Tepig |stage2=Pignite |type1=Fire |type2=Fighting |img=Nate Emboar Animated Trailer.png |epnum=Pokémon Black Version 2 and Pokémon White Version 2 Animated Trailer |epname=Pokémon Black Version 2 and Pokémon White Version 2 Animated Trailer |desc={{p|Emboar}} is the evolved form of Nate's first partner Pokémon, {{p|Tepig}}. It was seen on Nate's side when he prepared to challenge Elesa. Emboar's only known move is {{m|Flamethrower}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Nate |pkmn=Lucario |type1=Fighting |type2=Steel |img=Nate Lucario Aura Sphere Animated Trailer.png |epnum=Pokémon Black Version 2 and Pokémon White Version 2 Animated Trailer |epname=Pokémon Black Version 2 and Pokémon White Version 2 Animated Trailer |desc={{p|Lucario}} is Nate's second known Pokémon. It was first seen with Nate when he was talking with Colress, and later chasing a member of the Shadow Triad across the frozen Opelucid City alongside its Trainer. Lucario's only known move is {{m|Aura Sphere}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Nate |pkmn=Arcanine |type1=Fire |img=Nate Arcanine Animated Trailer.png |epnum=Pokémon Black Version 2 and Pokémon White Version 2 Animated Trailer |epname=Pokémon Black Version 2 and Pokémon White Version 2 Animated Trailer |desc={{p|Arcanine}} is Nate's third known Pokémon. It was seen alongside its Trainer aboard the Plasma Frigate, taking on a {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}'s {{p|Seviper}} alongside Hugh's {{p|Samurott}}. Arcanine's only known move is {{m|Bite}}.}} =====Voice actors===== {{vatable|color={{black 2 color}}|bordercolor={{black 2 color light}} |ja=入野自由 ''[[List of Japanese voice actors|Miyu Irino]]'' |en=[[Tom Wayland]] |es_eu=Antonio Domínguez}} ====GOTCHA!==== Nate briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ===In the manga=== [[File:Blake Adventures.png|thumb|120px|Nate's Pokémon Adventures counterpart, Blake]] ====Pokémon Adventures==== {{main|Blake (Adventures)}} Blake from [[Pokémon Adventures]] is modeled after Nate. He is a high-ranking member of the [[International Police]] and {{adv|Looker}}'s superior, who gets tasked with hunting down and arresting high-ranking members of [[Team Plasma]]. ====Pocket Monsters B2 W2 ~ A New Legend ~==== {{main|Arata}} Arata from [[Pocket Monsters B2 W2 ~ A New Legend ~]] is based on Nate's design. {{-}} ==In the TCG== The following is a list of cards featuring or mentioning Nate or his Pokémon in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. {{cardlist/header|Nate|Darkness|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|Legendary Treasures|Samurott|39}}|type=Water|expanded=yes|enset=Legendary Treasures|enrarity=Rare Holo|ennum=39/113|jpset=EX Battle Boost|jpnum=031/093}} {{cardlist/footer|Darkness}} ==Names== The name '''Nate''' (Japanese: '''キョウヘイ''' ''Kyouhei'') is used in-game when he appears as a non-player character. His Japanese name was spelled as '''Kyouhei''' on the packaging of [[Kotobukiya figurines|Kotobukiya ArtFX J Figure]].
